_doc: Which paths MUST stay in step between the live ADW surface and the SSSF skill
template surface, and which MAY diverge.
Pair roots come from .claude/skills/sssf/cookbooks/install.md's stamp table.
The two surfaces are NOT a subtree mirror: install.py maps
policy=mirrored      every file under the pair must be byte-identical, and the
file sets must match, unless a divergence entry says why.
divergences          per-path escapes from a mirrored pair. Each MUST carry a
reason and evidence, so an escape is a reviewed decision
rather than an accident that stopped failing.

divergences.reason: The template ships deliberately genericized placeholder blocks; the live copy is wired to Inkwell's real commands. A stamped repo cannot guess its own test runner, so the template must NOT carry Inkwell's argv.
divergences.evidence: .claude/skills/sssf/templates/adws/adw_modules/quality.py banner 'REPLACE THE PLACEHOLDER COMMANDS BELOW'; docs/increments/HD-02_ADW_SYNCHRONIZATION.md pins the shared API names run_inkwell_tests/run_inkwell_quality as the contract instead of the bodies.

divergences.reason: UNRESOLVED INTENT — landed live-only by B4-002 (PR 7, 923c0e4) and currently dormant: no module under adws/ imports it. Held out of the template pending a decision, NOT because divergence was shown to be intended. Do not copy to clear this entry; decide it.
divergences.evidence: docs/baseline/PROOF_MATRIX.md:100 asserts the shipped ADW path is unchanged by B4-002; docs/increments/B4-002_EXECUTOR_SUPERVISOR.md 'Boundaries and non-goals' is silent on the skill template surface.

divergences.reason: UNRESOLVED INTENT — same landing and same dormancy as pi_json_adapter.py. Held out of the template pending a decision, NOT because divergence was shown to be intended. Do not copy to clear this entry; decide it.
divergences.evidence: docs/baseline/PROOF_MATRIX.md:100; docs/increments/B4-002_EXECUTOR_SUPERVISOR.md 'Boundaries and non-goals' is silent on the skill template surface.

unpaired.reason: User-owned agent roster. install.md marks it user-owned and warns that --force overwrites operator edits, so the stamped starter roster and a repo's live roster are meant to diverge the moment they are stamped.
Live-only alternate roster; install.py stamps exactly one config. Alternate rosters are a live-surface concept.

unpaired.evidence: docs/baseline/PROOF_MATRIX.md:99 counts 'five rosters' as a live-surface property.
